saturation.reading: a burst of 5 is the first to be refused
saturation.depends_on_run_duration: The onset is a property of the workload as well as the queue. These runs take well under a second, so some finish while the burst is still arriving and the queue drains underneath it. A model-driven run takes tens of seconds and nothing drains during a burst, so refusal begins at the first submission past the configured capacity (concurrency + depth).

throughput.load_profile: fixture tasks on the deterministic path — no model call

model_driven_projection.basis: arithmetic from the concurrency limit and the median model-driven run duration measured by the eval harness; not observed under load

cold_start.measured_on: a local process with an empty data directory
cold_start.note: Container cold start adds image pull and container scheduling, which are the platform's and are not measured here.
